crossRefs.note: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

translations.web: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
translations.bsb: And none of this happened without an oath. For others became priests without an oath,
translations.kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath
translations.asv: And inasmuch as it is not without the taking of an oath
